scoring_justification: T1 recompute is infeasible because the PACHA optimization is too heavy for the checker sandbox; we instead use T0 result‑level compare for the Madelung energy and T3 structural audit for the phosphorus charges (P3 split and other P sites uniformity).

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference Madelung energy for the MIL‑50 PACHA‑optimised structure.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper reports ⟨EB⟩ = –36 563.9 kJ mol⁻¹ (paragraph immediately after the simplex convergence description).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Copied directly from the published value.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Extracted from the paper's own text; it is the experimentally‑backed reference the checker must match within tolerance.

schema.description: A single floating-point number in kJ/mol

outputs.description: Final Madelung lattice energy computed via the PACHA method after hydrogen optimization.

schema.description: JSON object with top-level keys P1, P2, P3, P4, P5; each value is an array of partial charge floats (number of entries matches site multiplicity in the pmc2_1 cell).

outputs.description: Partial charges of phosphorus atoms showing the symmetry lowering of the P3 site.

output_contract.notes: All outputs are produced from the final optimized primitive-cell geometry. The Madelung energy is checked against a hidden paper reference with tolerance; the phosphorus charges are verified for the expected P3 charge asymmetry and uniformity of other P sites.

steps.description: Compare the reported Madelung energy to the paper’s value within a tolerance.
Verify that only the P3 site shows a charge split (0.001 ≤ spread ≤ 0.005) and that all other P sites (P1, P2, P4, P5) have internal spread ≤ 0.001.
